statements.t: The Hansen & Adkins integration is progressing on schedule, with the Company on track to substantially complete integration by the end of the first quarter of 2027.

The Company expects to achieve the high end of its initial synergy range by year-end 2026, with additional opportunities from resource and portfolio optimization, real estate, insurance and SG&A consolidation expected in 2027 and further optimization and automation benefits through 2029.
In addition, convertible notes with a seven-year term were added at the time of the acquisition will be more fully described in our form 10-Q.
